facts.text: The action space is DiscreteMetaAction with five meta-actions: 0 LANE_LEFT, 1 IDLE, 2 LANE_RIGHT, 3 FASTER and 4 SLOWER
The action space is Discrete(len(actions)), five when both lateral and longitudinal actions are enabled
The Kinematics observation has the features presence, x, y, vx and vy and observes five vehicles by default
The Kinematics observation space is Box(-inf, inf, shape=(vehicles_count, len(features))), a (5, 5) array in the default configuration
The default configuration has 4 lanes, 50 vehicles, 1 controlled vehicle and an episode duration of 40 s
The simulation runs at 15 Hz and the policy at 1 Hz
Each policy step adds 1 / policy_frequency to the simulated time
The episode terminates when the ego vehicle has crashed, or when offroad_terminal is set and the vehicle is off the road
The episode is truncated when the simulated time reaches the configured duration
The reward weights are collision_reward -1, right_lane_reward 0.1 and high_speed_reward 0.4, with reward_speed_range [20, 30] and normalize_reward set
With normalize_reward the weighted reward is mapped from [collision_reward, high_speed_reward + right_lane_reward] to [0, 1] and multiplied by the on-road term
Vehicles of the default configuration are created at 25 m/s
The straight road network is built with speed_limit 30 m/s
The environment resets itself in AbstractEnv.__init__
reset(seed, options) forwards the seed to gym.Env.reset and rebuilds the spaces and the scene
highway-fast-v0 is the same environment with simulation_frequency 5, 3 lanes, 20 vehicles and a duration of 30 s
The repository registers exit-v0 and exit-v1 (ExitEnv and ConnectedLaneExitEnv) before highway-v0
The repository registers intersection-v0, intersection-v1 and intersection-v2 around IntersectionEnv

determinism.notes: reset(seed) reseeds the clone's numpy generator; the fake seeds Python's random.Random, so one seed gives different scenes and trajectories on the two

gaps: no vehicle dynamics: the fake is kinematic (F0), the ego vehicle keeps its speed for one policy step and the other vehicles drift at fixed speeds; the clone integrates kinematic and IDM vehicles over 15 simulation substeps per policy step (abstract.py:288-309)

no road network or lane geometry: a lane is an index 0 to 3, a collision is a distance check on the target lane when the ego changes lane, and the (5, 5) Kinematics observation is a flat 25-number stand-in (observation.py:166-172, 207-213)
the reward applies the default weights to the stand-in's speed and lane (highway_env.py:42-49) but the values of any particular episode are not the clone's
the fake returns the Kinematics observation as a flat 25-number list, the clone returns a (5, 5) float32 numpy array
no rendering, no pygame viewer, no record-video wrapper and no manual control
one tick is one policy step: it advances the simulated time by 1 s (policy_frequency 1 Hz), not by the 1/15 s simulation substep
the sim backend (gymnasium.make('highway-v0')) was not run: gymnasium, numpy, pandas, pygame-ce and noise are not installed where the gate runs

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
